hypotheses.S0_exact_recomposition: Native base and counterfactual suffix replays agree with the full forward pass to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.S1_late_window_compression: By Layer 14, a suffix window of at most 16 positions reaches 0.80 projection for at least three of four semantic families.
hypotheses.S2_late_window_beats_early_window: At Layer 12, the last-16-position transplant exceeds the first-16-causally-eligible-position transplant by at least 0.20 projection for at least three families.
hypotheses.S3_post_boundary_not_token_budget_artifa: At Layer 12, post-boundary projection exceeds an equal-count deterministic spread control by at least 0.10 for at least three families.
